graph.keyboardHint: Arrow keys move the selection to the nearest node in that direction, Enter opens a group or acts on the node, Escape clears the selection, plus and minus zoom, 0 shows everything.
graph.communities.tooLarge: Communities are computed for graphs up to {limit} nodes.
graph.notice.cut: Showing the {shown} best connected of {count} nodes, the limit of this panel. Narrow the query or raise the limit in the panel options.
graph.notice.truncated: The data source cut the result at its limit, so the graph may be incomplete.
graph.notice.dangling: {count} edges lead to nodes outside the result and are not drawn.
graph.notice.clustered: More than {count} nodes: nodes are grouped by label. Open a group to see its nodes.
graph.notice.noWebgl: This browser cannot draw graphs (WebGL 2 is missing), so the graph is shown as a table.
graph.notice.cycles: {count} edges close a cycle and point upwards.
graph.cluster.caption: {label} ({count})
graph.explorer.noKind: Explorer mode is not available for this kind of data source yet.
graph.explorer.noRight: Loading neighbours needs query access to the data source.
graph.explorer.notGraph: The data source did not answer with a graph.
graph.gesture.wheel: Hold Ctrl to zoom with the wheel
graph.gesture.touch: Use two fingers to move the graph
graph.time.label: Graph at
graph.table.name: Name
graph.path.none: The result has no paths. Return paths from the query, for example with shortestPath.
graph.path.title: Path {number}, {count} steps
graph.options.caption: Node name property (optional)
graph.options.captionHint: Empty uses name, title or a similar property.
graph.options.colorByHint: Communities are computed for graphs up to {limit} nodes.
graph.options.colorBy.label: Label
graph.options.edgeWidthByHint: A number property of the edges, such as weight. Empty draws all edges equally.
graph.options.nodeLimitHint: At most {max}. Beyond the limit, the best connected nodes are shown.
graph.options.cluster.label: Always
graph.options.timePropertyHint: Edges with a timestamp in this property get a time slider.
graph.options.explorer: Explorer mode: clicking a node loads its neighbours
graph.options.variableHint: A dashboard variable, so other panels follow the node.
graph.options.variableNone: The dashboard has no variables yet. Add one in the dashboard settings.
